Roving Close Up MagicJack Daniels

Jack Daniels is a master magician and grand illusionist with over 30 years of experience captivating audiences around the globe.

Named Australia’s Magician of the Year in 2020/2021 and winner of the world’s largest magic competition, Jack has shared stages with legends, including a personal invitation to collaborate with David Copperfield in Las Vegas.

From television appearances to VIP performances for heads of state, he delivers shows that blend grand spectacle with intimate magic that happens right in the audience’s hands.

Quoted rate is per hour.
Guest capacity range: 1 hour reaches between 50 - 80 guests.
Bookings beyond 1 hour should allow a 10min break in performance to replenish items and props.
